# Droid Vault 4.0.1

## Fixed in this release

- **Your backup folder can be copied off the phone and put back.** Backup
  folders named after an app with a colon in its name — "Tachiyomi:
  Mangakakalot" — carried a character Android's storage, Windows and most file
  managers refuse, so copying the vault back onto a phone stopped at the first
  such folder and left everything else behind with it. Those folders are
  renamed the first time the app starts after this update. Your backups are the
  same backups; only the folder names change, and the vault's own record of
  which ones were already checked moves with them, so nothing has to be read
  again to earn it back.

- **Restoring messages is much faster.** It used to start a system command for
  every single message; a 96-message restore spent 104 seconds doing that, and
  the same item now takes a quarter of a second.

- **A slow run can be explained from its own log.** Every backup and restore
  now writes down how long each app and each of its parts took, so a run that
  takes far longer than it should can be diagnosed from what it recorded
  instead of from guesswork.

## Upgrading

Install over your existing copy — your settings, labels, app assignments,
configurations and scheduled jobs are kept.

This replaces 4.0.0 directly.

## Download

| File | For |
|---|---|
| `arm64-v8a-release.apk` | Almost all phones from 2017 onward |
| `armeabi-v7a-release.apk` | Older 32-bit phones |

Not sure? Take the 64-bit one.

**Needs** a rooted device (Magisk, KernelSU or APatch) and Android 10+.

Please keep a second backup somewhere else.
